Do you have logistics experience and a technical mindset? Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you! This is a full-time position (40 hours per week), mainly from Monday to Friday. Occasionally, you may work evening or weekend shifts, so flexibility is important.

In this role, you will be responsible for receiving, inspecting, processing, and preparing a wide variety of goods for shipment. You will work with high-value and time-critical shipments where accuracy, quality, and a structured approach are essential. Thanks to the diverse range of tasks and products, no two days are ever the same.

As a warehouse operator, you and your colleagues will ensure the warehouse operates efficiently. You will receive and process incoming goods, pick orders, prepare shipments for dispatch, and carefully pack, label, and inspect products. You will also manage packaging materials, maintain a clean and organized warehouse, and assist with the storage of sensitive goods, including medical products. In addition, you will install computers for new employees and help resolve minor technical issues.

- Must have lived in Europe for at least 8 consecutive years (required for a security screening VGB)
- 1 - 2 years of experience in a logistics or warehouse environment
- You are available to work morning and evening shifts during peak periods, including weekends.
- Good command of either Dutch or English
- Technical aptitude and basic computer skills
